name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

jobName.description: The name of the created workflow

model.description:
The model to be retrained. Note that this is not expected to be the
[source of truth model](FaultySensor.RiskModelSourceOfTruthRelation)

relation.description:
The relation between the model and the asset, if applicable. This is the relation to the asset for which it's
{@link Sensor} was faulty.

This process currently does not support multiple assets for a single model.

validationResult.description: The validation result from the [faulty sensor map reduce job](FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob).

title:
See {@link FaultySensor} for details about the overall faulty sensor process.

Trains a new model without the faulty sensors, and performs relevant post-processing.

See {@link FaultySensor.Orchestrator#createRetrainSpecFromValidationResult} for how this is created.
See #createWorkflow to understand how this process executes.
name: FaultySensor.Orchestrator.Spec.Process
